At 1440px, <div.satellites > div.sat.sat5.down > span.sv> "−4.41%" at 13px over section.field (background-image): #ff4d63 is under 4.5:1 across 100% of one pixel row through its glyphs (3.66:1 on #3c2879). Give the text a flat ground that clears the ratio (a background on its own box), or stop the lines, image or layer behind it short of the text.

1. (Judgment 4: order and carrier at 360) The filmstrip doesn't follow the declared `order` of hero, selected work index, signal telemetry, about blurb, callout, footer. After the satellite column in fold 2, the about blurb ("The shop is Spaceman. The products came out of it…") comes first at the top of fold 3, and the telemetry follows it. No selected-work index with its `3xl` section head appears anywhere. Add the work index right after the hero, then telemetry, then move the about blurb below telemetry.
2. (Judgment 6: header `height_px`) The declaration says 112px, but at 1440 the mast runs from the mark down past the numbered nav to about 187px before the field starts. Tighten the space between the mark, the wordmark and the nav row so the mast stands near 112px and the hero field gains the height back.
3. (Judgment 3: deck) At 1440 the deck "FishSticks, 15th Club, and the next one." breaks onto a second line with "one." alone on it. The same break happens at 360. Widen the deck's measure, or balance the line breaks, so the second beat doesn't end on a single orphaned word under the centred planet.

1. (Judgment 4) At 360, fold 1 holds the logo, "Spaceman" and its deck as it should. But the FishSticks satellite card, and the top of the next one, also sit inside the first 640px. The Mobile Declaration's `first_fold` says "the hero alone… and nothing else." Push the satellite column below the fold, either by letting the hero field fill the fold or by moving the satellites into fold 2.
2. (Judgment 5) The About blurb says "FishSticks and 15th Club shipped from it." The records list 15th Club as "In Development" with the outcome "In active development." Only FishSticks is "Live." Reword it so 15th Club is still being built, for example "FishSticks shipped from it, 15th Club is in the works, and so will the next one."
3. (Judgment 6) At 1440 the centered top-bar mast is about 145px tall from the top edge to where the violet field starts, against the declared `height_px: 112`. Tighten the gap between the mark, the wordmark and the numbered nav row so the mast comes close to 112.

The design works because the outline-glowing "Spaceman" sits alone at the centre of a violet mesh field, with real products and the day's signals placed around it as satellites; at 360 that orbit becomes the declared launch sequence (word and deck alone in fold 1, then the satellite column, selected work, telemetry, about and the readout footer), and every work claim matches the records.
